verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community comment. It says that when deleting, Superhuman lets you trash or mark done all messages from the same sender, which is a native one-stroke bulk action but scoped to one sender. Auto Archive and Split Inbox are automatic or focus features, not user-selected bulk actions, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of arbitrary multi-select of conversations, bulk archive and bulk label of a hand-picked selection, the keyboard workflow for selecting many threads, and corroboration beyond one community remark.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
